latest_release.name: v2.17.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update README exchange tables for v2.16.0 by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8402
* Update README for master: exchange tables, Getting Started, Strategies by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8403
* Feat/std executor config failures by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8421
* fix / Hyperliquid auth silently accepting wrong private keys (#7866) by @ipezygj in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8212
* Fix Hyperliquid builder fee not resolving when connector is embedded by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8417
* (derive) rename config keys to reflect session-key auth by @david-hummingbot in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8430
* feat(gateway): adopt the unified route surface, and give executors a slippage ramp by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8431
* feat(gateway): add token discovery client method by @mlguys in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8441
* feat(gateway): trim the client's Gateway commands and fix their autocomplete by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8438
* feat/lp-executor: add configurable position refresh interval by @mlguys in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8446
* (perf) bound the controller's executor view in backtesting, and report closing-tick executors by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8447
* (feat) add kalshi_perpetual connector by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8454
* fix(xrpl): resolve token symbols for markets without a trading_pair_symbol by @david-hummingbot in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8448
* (fix) emulate reduce_only for resting kalshi_perpetual close orders by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8464
* Sync / Development to Staging v2.17 by @rapcmia in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8459
* Sync / Staging to master  v2.17 by @rapcmia in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8467


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/compare/v2.16.0...v2.17.0
